newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's rates Dao Heng sub notes Baa1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates Dao Heng sub notes Baa1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it had assigned a Baa1 rating to Dao Heng Bank's US$350 million subordinated notes due 2007.
Moody's also said it affirmed Dao Heng Bank's A3 long-term/Prime-2 short-term deposit ratings and its bank financial strength rating (BFSR) of C.

Moody's said Dao Heng's ratings reflect its good capital levels, strong asset quality and high profitability as well as the bank's uncertain operating environment due to Hong Kong's transition to Chinese sovereignty on June 30, 1997.

Dao Heng's relatively small franchise in Hong Kong, where the market is dominated by two large banking groups, HSBC Holdings Plc's Hongkong Bank group and the Bank of China group, also is a negative factor in the ratings, it said.
With consolidated assets of HK$103 billion as of June 1996, Dao Heng Bank is Hong Kong's third largest locally incorporated bank, Moody's said.

Moody's said that Hong Kong's transition to China raises questions about the future operating environment of Hong Kong banks. Nevertheless, banks in Hong Kong are entering the transition period with generally strong financial fundamentals, the rating agency said.
